nota: Traducerile celor 50 de fapte (docs/fapte_de_verificat.md), în ordinea lor. Faptul verificat e cel din engleză.
fapte: Water freezes into ice when it is very cold.
Birds have feathers.
The Sun is a star.
Plants need water and sunlight to grow.
The Moon goes around the Earth.
Bees make honey from the nectar of flowers.
Fish breathe through their gills.
Rain falls from clouds.
Spiders have eight legs.
Frogs start their lives as tadpoles in the water.
A caterpillar changes into a butterfly.
Cows give milk.
Brushing your teeth helps keep them healthy.
A rainbow can appear when sunlight shines through raindrops.
Many trees lose their leaves in autumn.
Sea water is salty.
Magnets pull things made of iron.
The heart pumps blood around the body.
Bats are mammals that can fly.
Penguins are birds that cannot fly, but they swim very well.
Hot melted rock called lava comes out of volcanoes.
A shadow forms when something blocks the light.
Water boils when it gets very hot.
Many owls hunt at night.
Camels can go a long time without drinking water.
Elephants use their trunks to drink water and to pick things up.
Stars are very far away from the Earth.
Wind is moving air.
Ants live and work together in big groups called colonies.
A big tree can grow from a small seed.
Snakes have no legs.
Whales breathe air through a blowhole on top of their heads.
Ice cream melts when it gets warm.
It gets dark at night because our side of the Earth turns away from the Sun.
Our bodies need sleep to stay healthy.
Bread is made from flour.
Hens lay eggs.
A turtle carries its shell with it everywhere.
We see lightning before we hear the thunder.
It is usually colder at the top of a high mountain.
Dogs have a very good sense of smell.
Cats can see well when there is little light.
Apples grow on trees.
The Earth goes around the Sun once every year.
Squirrels hide nuts to eat in the winter.
Some bears sleep through most of the winter.
Carrots grow under the ground.
Clouds are made of tiny drops of water.
Sand is made of tiny pieces of rock and shells.
Washing your hands with soap helps wash away germs.
